body:
Adds `research/demo-twin` (builds on the CAIRO/HIRO learning-from-demonstration and sim-to-real directions; no affiliation implied).

- Applied-action logs bias a linear clone even in a perfect twin (gain 0.582 vs 0.963, +9.8% real cost); Stein closed form for Gaussian states.
- Twin errors act through visited states and can help; narrow coverage recovers the expert; DAgger with applied-action labels is worse (gap 0.169 vs 0.141).
- 7 tests pass; grid checked against refinement and Monte Carlo. Stylised scalar plant.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
